MINDE

/ˈmin.dɛ/ (verb · Lojban)

To command a desktop through live, inspectable Scheme.

Minde is a Wayland compositor for people who want to understand and alter the machinery they use all day. Smithay owns the protocol, rendering, and input; Guile owns policy. Inspect it, redefine it, or drive it over local IPC while the session is alive.

Evaluate

Keymaps, hooks, placement, groups, and frames are live Guile procedures — change behavior without restarting the session.

Compose

Groups, heads, and explicit frames instead of a fixed layout algorithm; the window model descends from StumpWM.

Interrogate

The local IPC interface exposes state, evaluation, status, and structured events to scripts and Eww.

Hack safely

The nested backend exercises the real policy layer without touching DRM, your VT, or the display manager.

Try it without touching your session:

guix shell -m manifest.scm
scripts/run-nested
